rulings.kept: 18 windows per Solana token in the claim window, for the estimates' precision
rulings.ruling: C2b's Solana half (SOL; the Solana stablecoins pooled) gets estimates with intervals, not a verdict. A verdict must be reachable both ways at its primary tau (90%). The window-level bound gives an all-Omni stratum a lower limit of 0.025^(1/m), which reaches 90% only at m >= 36 (35 gives 0.89997, 36 gives 0.90261), m being Kish's effective count over window amounts, never above the window count. Option 1 (enough windows) does not fit: it needs 36 to 54 more windows even with equal window amounts, and about 162 more at SOL's measured spread, against 23 credits to spare.

btc.omft.near is read whole in both flow strata (one window per piece, weight 1), so that BTC's verdict can go either way. With 6 sampled windows of about 16 days in the 28-day claim stratum, the all-POA upper limit stayed at or above 50% in most simulated draws, so BTC could not read contradicted even if POA carried it.
